money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam. Originals of EMD (or MSME certificate) and all technical documents to reach the office by registered/speed post or in person by 15.12.2022 15:00.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR, for contractors from the Lakshadweep group of islands, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 05 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); non-blacklisting affidavit on Rs 100 non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure VIII)
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping/DGLL (Annexure VII); documentary evidence of annual turnover of last three years
